SELECT uld_stats_sn AS "uldStatsSn", /* 업로드통계일련번호 */ pblnt_sn AS "pblntSn", /* 공시일련번호 */ ptcp_inst_sn AS "ptcpInstSn", /* 참여기관일련번호 */ uld_nocs AS "uldNocs", /* 업로드건수 */ uld_cpct AS "uldCpct", /* 업로드용량 */ err_nocs AS "errNocs", /* 오류건수 */ err_rt AS "errRt", /* 오류율 */ rgtr_id AS "rgtrId", /* 등록자아이디 */ reg_dt AS "regDt" /* 등록일시 */ FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_ULD_STATS_HIST WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} /* 공시번호 필터 (다른 공시 데이터 제외) */
AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} /* 협력기관 화면: 기관일련번호 필터 (다른 기관 데이터 제외) */
ORDER BY reg_dt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT h.uld_stats_sn AS "uldStatsSn", h.pblnt_sn AS "pblntSn", h.ptcp_inst_sn AS "ptcpInstSn", pblnt.ttl_nm AS "pblntTtlNm", h.uld_nocs AS "uldNocs", h.uld_cpct AS "uldCpct", h.err_nocs AS "errNocs", h.err_rt AS "errRt", h.rgtr_id AS "rgtrId", AS "rgtrNm", h.reg_dt AS "regDt" FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_ULD_STATS_HIST h LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PBLNT pblnt ON pblnt.pblnt_sn = h.pblnt_sn WHERE h.ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} ORDER BY h.reg_dt DESC

SELECT h.tbl_uld_stats_sn AS "tblUldStatsSn", /* 테이블업로드통계일련번호 */ h.pblnt_sn AS "pblntSn", /* 공시일련번호 */ h.ptcp_inst_sn AS "ptcpInstSn", /* 참여기관일련번호 */ h.trsf_se_cd AS "trsfSeCd", /* 변환구분코드 (01: Sentinel, 02: OMOP) */ h.err_tbl_nm AS "errTblNm", /* 오류테이블명 */ h.uld_nocs AS "uldNocs", /* 업로드건수 */ h.err_nocs AS "errNocs", /* 오류건수 */ h.vrfc_fnl_err_nocs AS "vrfcFnlErrNocs", /* 검증최종오류건수 */ h.vrfc_unq_err_nocs AS "vrfcUnqErrNocs", /* 검증유일성오류건수 */ h.vrfc_vld_err_nocs AS "vrfcVldErrNocs", /* 검증유효성오류건수 */ h.vrfc_nml_err_nocs AS "vrfcNmlErrNocs", /* 검증정합성오류건수 */ h.err_rt AS "errRt", /* 오류율 */ h.uld_vrfc_sn AS "uldVrfcGrpSn", /* 검증 실행 그룹 */ h.uld_rul_sn AS "vrfcRuleId", /* 룰 ID(요약 행 NULL) */ h.uld_rul_type_nm AS "vrfcRuleTpCd", h.vrfc_rul_err_nocs AS "vrfcRuleErrNocs", h.rgtr_id AS "rgtrId", /* 등록자아이디 */ h.reg_dt AS "regDt", /* 등록일시 */ m.levl_seq AS "levlSeq", m.vrfc_tbl_nm AS "vrfcTblNm", m.vrfc_col_nm AS "vrfcColNm", m.vrfc_rul_nm AS "vrfcRulNm", m.rfrnc_nm AS "rfrncNm", m.rfrnc_dtl_nm AS "rfrncDtlNm", m.esntl_yn AS "esntlYn", m.rfrnc_tbl_nm AS "rfrncTblNm", m.rfrnc_col_nm AS "rfrncColNm", m.fk_nm AS "fkNm", m.std_trm_id AS "stdTrmId", m.rul_aplcn_nm AS "rulAplcnNm", m.unit_nm AS "unitNm", m.scp_seq_nm AS "scpSeqNm", m.prm_crtr_nm AS "prmCrtrNm", m.vrbl_cn AS "vrblCn", m.vrbl_dtl_cn AS "vrblDtlCn", m.vrbl_rslt_cn AS "vrblRsltCn" FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_TBL_ULD_STATS_HIST h LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_cm_m_vrfc m ON m.vrfc_sn = h.uld_rul_sn WHERE h.pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} /* 공시번호 필터 (다른 공시 데이터 제외) */
AND h.ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} /* 협력기관 화면: 기관일련번호 필터 (다른 기관 데이터 제외) */
AND (h.del_yn IS NULL OR h.del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY h.reg_dt DESC

SELECT uld_list_sn AS "uldListSn", /* 업로드목록일련번호 */ pblnt_sn AS "pblntSn", /* 공시일련번호 */ ptcp_inst_sn AS "ptcpInstSn", /* 참여기관번호 */ tbl_se_cd AS "tblSeCd", /* 테이블구분코드 */ col_nm AS "colNm", /* 컬럼명 */ data_type_nm AS "dataTypeNm", /* 자료유형명 */ nul_yn AS "nulYn", /* 널여부 */ pk_yn AS "pkYn", /* 기본키여부 */ fk_yn AS "fkYn", /* 외래키여부 */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tbl_se_cd ORDER BY uld_list_sn) AS "rowNumber" /* 행번호 */ FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_CTLG WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} /* 공시일련번호 */
AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} /* 참여기관번호: 전달된 값과 일치하는 경우 */
